newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palmoil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed on Wednesday for the Buddhist Wesak day observance. The markets reopen on Thursday, May 22.
On Tuesday, palm oil prices finished slightly lower on lack of follow-through support after cautious trading ahead of the holiday.
Traders said despite supportive crop report from forecaster Ivan Wong and friendly May 1-20 export data, the market was easier due to losses in Chicago soyoil futures overnight.
At the close, the August futures contract closed 10 ringgit down at 1,210 ringgit ($483.90) a tonne.
